scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 better preserves source-like nearest-neighbor spacing, total instance count and clustering under the same tissue geometry and quota.
Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 has closer source-relative spacing, count and clustering with essentially matched instance size.
All hard gates pass and mask review shows coherent moderate tumor-boundary expansion. Candidate 03 best preserves source-like nearest-neighbor spacing, total instance count and local clustering.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 46,926-pixel expansion follows authorized external tumor-stroma interfaces and preserves adjacent immune and non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Thirty-eight class-1 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.997, 1.145, 0.999 and 0.861.
decisions.coupling: Added tumor nuclei occupy authorized expanded footprints; boundary, seam, quota, compatibility, distribution and density gates pass with sampling score 0.889.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and structures outside joint support remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: Total instance count is 14.5% above source and clustering is lower, but both remain within frozen limits. Mask-only evidence is not generated-H&E or clinical validation.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff.
